Frontend E2E: Login → Settings → tab Template Dokumen works, RichText toolbar buttons (bold/italic/underline/insertOrderedList/insertUnorderedList) present for both invoice & quotation terms with correct data-testids. 'Simpan template' returns PUT 200 and toast success. Preview PDF works for kind=Invoice (200 application/pdf) and kind=Kwitansi (200 application/pdf). CRITICAL BUG FOUND: Preview PDF for kind=Quotation returns HTTP 500 when the RichText editor produced … markup (which is what Chrome's execCommand('italic') actually emits in this app because the editor inherits inline styles). Root cause: _clean_terms sanitizer's whitelist regex `<(?!/?(?:b|i|u)>|br/>)[^>]*>` only preserves *bare* opening tags like ``, ``, `` (immediately followed by `>`). When the browser emits `…`, the opening tag has attributes and is STRIPPED, but the matching closing `` is KEPT (it still matches the whitelist), producing unbalanced markup like `Syarat quotationBerlaku 30 hari` which crashes reportlab paraparser (`ValueError: saw instead of expected `). Same class of bug also affects ``, ``, and `

critical.issue:
500 InternalServerError when quotation_terms/invoice_terms contains tags with attributes like ``. _clean_terms only preserves bare `//` and strips their attribute-carrying variants, leaving orphan closing tags → reportlab paraparser raises `Parse error: saw instead of expected `. Reproduced with body {"kind":"quotation","quotation_terms":"Syarat quotation
  • Berlaku 30 hari
"} → 500. Same input with plain `` → 200. Currently persisted quotation_terms in DB is `Syarat quotation
Berlaku 30 hari
` so *any* subsequent quotation preview and any quotation PDF that references saved terms will 500 until fixed.

minor.issue: Returns 500 as text/plain instead of a structured JSON error; frontend surfaces generic 'Gagal membuat preview' toast without server detail.

ui_bugs.issue: execCommand('italic'/'bold'/'underline') on selected text emits `<i style="...">` / `<font color="...">` / `<span style="...">` rather than bare `<b>/<i>/<u>` because the contentEditable inherits inline typography styles. That output round-trips into save and preview and triggers the backend 500 above. Recommendation: normalize output at the client (strip inline styles, unwrap non-b/i/u/br/ol/ul/li tags) before sending, OR (preferred) fix _clean_terms to handle attributed variants.

integration_issues.issue: After typing 'Syarat quotation' + Italic + Unordered List and clicking 'Preview PDF', backend returns 500 and iframe shows toast 'Gagal membuat preview'. Same flow for Invoice and Kwitansi works (200 application/pdf).

rca of the issue.bug: POST /api/doc-template/preview 500 for kind=quotation (and any kind whose terms contain attributed <i>/<b>/<u> tags).
rca of the issue.reproduction: 1) Login as Super Admin. 2) Settings → Template Dokumen. 3) Focus quotation-terms editor, type text, Ctrl+A, click italic button, then insertUnorderedList. 4) Save (PUT succeeds). 5) Set preview-kind = Quotation, click Preview PDF. Observed: toast 'Gagal membuat preview' + 500 text/plain. Backend log: 'Parse error: saw instead of expected ' at reportlab paraparser, called from build_document_pdf line 3622 via _clean_terms.
rca of the issue.root_cause: _clean_terms regex `<(?!/?(?:b|i|u)>|br/>)[^>]*>` requires the opening tag to be *bare* (``, ``, ``), i.e. character immediately after tag letter is `>`. Real contentEditable output is `…` — the opening does NOT match the whitelist and gets stripped, while `` (bare closing) DOES match and stays. Result: unbalanced `` orphan tags inside , which crashes reportlab.paraparser.end_i().
rca of the issue.mitigation: Normalize b/i/u tags before applying the strip pass. Minimal patch in _clean_terms (before the final strip): `s = re.sub(r'<(/?)(b|i|u)(\s[^>]*)?>', r'<\1\2>', s, flags=re.I)`. Additionally strip inline wrappers like <font …>/<span …>. Also wrap doc_template_preview in try/except returning JSONResponse(status_code=422, content={'detail': str(e)}) so the UI can surface the underlying reason.
